project_metadata.art_direction: Swiss High-Contrast Display Typography mixed with Cinematic Dark Obsidian Luxury and Tactile Code Terminal details. High motion intensity, line-by-line kinetic hero reveal, smooth Lenis inertia, editorial bento project showcase, custom cursor, and subtle noise grain overlay.

rules: DO NOT use Inter or standard Roboto for headings — headings MUST use Cabinet Grotesk with tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
All eyebrow tags, status chips, section counters (e.g., 01 // PROJECTS), and metadata MUST use JetBrains Mono in uppercase with wide tracking.
Headings over 32px MUST use tight line-height (leading-none or leading-[0.95]) to eliminate empty vertical spaces.
Body text MUST remain left-aligned for maximum scanability and editorial legibility.

colors.archetype: Architectural Dark Obsidian & Kinetic Warm Ember
rules: Never use pure black #000000; use #08080A tinted with cold indigo/obsidian shadow.
Limit accent color (#FF4F00) to interactive elements, status beacons, focus lines, and kinetic highlights. Never flood background with full-screen gradients.
Glassmorphism overlays MUST include backdrop-blur-xl (min 16px) with saturation boost backdrop-saturate-150 and crisp 1px border_subtle.

layout_and_grid.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x normal). Page sections separated by py-24 to py-36 (96px - 144px). Containers use p-6 to p-12.

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis Smooth Scroll mandatory across entire page for inertia and luxury weight.
motion_and_effects.hero_kinetic_reveal: Masked line-by-line slide-up reveal for name 'Vivek Nishad' on page load, followed by role badge and action triggers.
motion_and_effects.custom_cursor: Dual-ring magnetic trailing cursor with blend mode backdrop-difference and hover expansion state on interactive cards and buttons.
motion_and_effects.noise_texture: Fixed SVG noise grain overlay with 0.03 opacity spanning full viewport z-50 pointer-events-none.
motion_and_effects.editorial_marquee: react-fast-marquee strip with slow speed (25px/s), featuring bold outlined display text ('COMPUTER SCIENCE HONS // MACHINE LEARNING // FULL STACK ARCHITECTURE // DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS //').

creative_3d_element.type: Interactive Three.js Canvas / WebGL Mesh Field
creative_3d_element.description: Subtle 3D kinetic wireframe sphere / particle wave responding to mouse movement in Hero background with floating depth layer.
creative_3d_element.lighting: Adequate directional rim light + ambient illumination to make geometry look sharp and metallic against dark obsidian background.
creative_3d_element.fallback: Smooth animated SVG noise grid with ambient glowing radial gradient if WebGL context is deferred.

accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: All body text meets APCA standard with light gray #F4F4F7 on #08080A (contrast > 12:1). Accent text uses bright warm orange (#FF4F00) against dark surfaces.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Focus rings styled with explicit 2px solid #FF4F00 outline and outline-offset-2.
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: All Framer Motion animations strictly respect prefers-reduced-motion media query via motion controls.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based attributes attached to every interactive button, input, link, navigation item, project card, and contact link.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all' in CSS, as it breaks Framer Motion transform animations. Use explicit property transitions e.g. 'transition: opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease'.
DO NOT center align the app container or body (no text-align: center on App container). Keep editorial left alignment.
All header/navbar drop-downs or sticky bars MUST have a non-transparent background (use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#08080A]/80 border-b border-white/10) to prevent text overlap during scrolling.
DO NOT use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use ONLY the curated high-resolution unsplash URLs provided in the 'image_urls' section.
Every key interactive element MUST carry a descriptive data-testid attribute for automated testing validation.
Ensure Lenis smooth scroll is wrapped at the top level in App.js with proper cleanup on unmount.
Create a memorable original SVG logo mark for Vivek Nishad ('VN' monogram with geometric lines) and inject it into public/index.html as favicon as well as Navbar logo.
